text: The same slips as 0202 (one column read out of place, or two swapped) for the three remaining families: trapezoids, letters reshuffled inside rows, and the poem code.
Each slipped route and its inverse, then or before a repeating key of 1-26 on the sculpture's tables, K4 against ten scrambled copies and a planted slip per family.

Trapezoid and poem code at the copies' rate. Row reshuffle: K4 above every copy in 6 cells, no copy in more than 1. Outside the copies' range, so the queue stops: 0204 replicates it against 40 fresh copies. Plants found 3 of 3.
